elements.name: PMOSFET
elements.description: PFET4 Level 1 (Shichman-Hodges) bidirectional DC channel model with body effect and lambda = CLM_C/Leff. id is signed from the fixed d pin to the fixed s pin and is negative in normal PMOS operation. The higher-voltage channel pin acts as internal source; the roles swap automatically when d > s. b defaults to the fixed s pin unless connected explicitly; body must satisfy b >= max(d,s). W, L, LD and TOX are in metres; UO is in cm^2/(V*s); CLM_C is in m/V. No capacitances, body-diode currents, subthreshold conduction or temperature dependence.
equations: body_root = if(channel_vsb >= 0, sqrt(PHI + channel_vsb), max(0, sqrt_phi + channel_vsb/(2*sqrt_phi)))
id = if(vds >= 0, 1, -1) * if(vov <= 0, 0, if(channel_vds < vov, K * (vov*channel_vds - channel_vds^2/2) * (1 + LAMBDA*channel_vds), K/2 * vov^2 * (1 + LAMBDA*channel_vds)))
